newsitem.title: USA: Paxar to buy rest of Monarch Marking.
newsitem.headline: Paxar to buy rest of Monarch Marking.

text.p: Paxar Corp said Friday that it will buy the 55 percent of Monarch Marking Systems it does not already own for $130 million in cash, warrants and Paxar common shares.

Paxar said it has executed an agreement with the private investment firm of Odyssey Partners LP and reached an agreement in principle with Monarch Marking Systems to buy their equity ownership in Monarch.
Paxar said the acquisition should close in mid-February after clearing the federal antitrust waiting period. It said no organizational changes are planned after the acquisition.
Ohio-based Monarch supplies bar codes to retail and industrial customers.
Paxar said Monarch has added significantly to its earnings since its initial acquisition in 1995.
Paxar shares were unchanged Friday morning at 16-3/4.
